summary: XTL Biopharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K reporting a Nasdaq Staff delisting determination due to failure to file its annual report on Form 20-F, adding to existing deficiencies in stockholders' equity and bid price. The company intends to request a stay of suspension before the May 26, 2026 deadline and will present its views to the Nasdaq Hearings Panel. No price terms or advisors are mentioned. The filing maps to a U.S. delisting proceeding under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1). Watch the Panel's decision on continued listing and the company's ability to regain compliance.
